title: Feature request : add the possibility to inject later (or set a reminder alert)
symptom: A user who digests carbohydrates slowly experiences low blood glucose if they inject insulin at the start of meals. They want to either delay the injection or set a reminder to inject later.
fix: Use the wizard at the end of the meal and set negative carbs time.
evidence_quote: use wizard at the end of meal and set negative carbs time
